name: lead-pipeline
summary: The people at a company, each with a checked work email, in one call. Provider calls at cost, plus $0.01 only per person whose email is valid or risky.

country.note: ISO country code, where the provider supports it

limit.note: people to return; at most 9, or 6 with include_phone (20 calls per run)

include_phone.note: also look up a phone number for each person; about $0.25 per phone, far more than an email

max_spend_usd.note: the most the provider calls may cost in one run, up to 1.80; the run stops early and returns what it has. A phone costs about $0.25
